title: Explosion hits house in Gaza's Bureij Camp amid Israeli attack
description:
💥 Footage captured the moment an Israeli military attack struck a house in the central Gaza Strip's Bureij refugee camp, sending thick plumes of smoke into the air

▪️ In the immediate aftermath, local residents rushed toward the explosion site
